description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing them in a LinkedList, including helper functions for validation of tokens.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object providing string tokenization utilities, including splitting a source string into tokens and validating tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens based on spaces and returns a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is non-empty.
